steps.caption: Team tab
steps.narration: Roles decide what each person on your team can see and do. Here is how to set them.

steps.caption: Team members
steps.narration: On the Team tab, under Team members, everyone has a role.

steps.caption: Owen Brooks
steps.narration: Owen is a project manager. The switches show what he can do.

steps.caption: The i beside a role
steps.narration: Click the i beside a role to read what it's for.

steps.caption: Role: Project manager
steps.narration: A project manager runs jobs once they're sold. The back office stays with owners and admins.

steps.caption: Change a role
steps.chapter: Change a role or one permission
steps.narration: To change a role, pick a new one from the list. We'll make Priya office staff.

steps.caption: Team member updated
steps.narration: The CRM says Team member updated, and her role is now office.

steps.caption: One permission
steps.narration: You can also change one thing for one person. Let's let Owen see costs and margins.

steps.caption: Still a project manager
steps.narration: The switch is on, and Owen is still a project manager.

steps.caption: The owner
steps.narration: The owner has every permission, and that can't be changed here.

steps.caption: Menu: Team & Company
steps.narration: You'll find roles under Team and Company in the menu.

youtube.title: How to set team roles and permissions | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of roles and permissions in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will read what a role is for, change a team member's role, and switch one permission on for one person.
